answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat block bulk identity forgery. Each epoch the beacon wakes 3% of identities, demanding a signed reply proving work. Two misses knock an identity off the knoll of standing. Each puppet needs its own heartbeat of compute and a cipher key, so N identities cost N times compute per epoch while an honest agent pays once. Only passers build the shale of reputation: honest work compounds, sybil capital bleeds.
